mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <30% of instances during FEDFUNDS declines, or the 20d returns are not statistically significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (high unemployment benefit claims and rising unemployment rates), a sustained increase in unemployment rates (UNRATE) triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not negative despite UNRATE crossing the threshold in the regime, or returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both rise >5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive despite both proxies rising >5%, or the returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in industrial production (INDPRO) alongside falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) indicates strong supply-side momentum, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises >2% and FEDFUNDS falls >1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite both conditions met, or returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in personal consumption (GDPC1) above 13,350 suggests robust demand growth, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite GDPC1 crossing the threshold, or returns not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signal monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% and CPIAUCSL rises >1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5d returns not negative despite both proxies rising, or returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over time indicates robust supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive despite sustained INDPRO increases, or returns not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
